315.whatChanged: Threads show only the avatar: no kind chip or role label on any thread kind. The reply count ignores the opening comment, so a lone comment shows no count.
315.whatToTry: Add a comment and look at its header and the collapsed row.
315.caveats: Explain replies no longer show their question line.

321.whatChanged: The stack badge (1/3) now sits inside the repo#PR button in the review top bar; clicking it opens the stack popover.
321.whatToTry: Open a review of a stacked PR and click the badge.

322.whatChanged: Chrome extension: a Review in Unvibe button on GitHub PRs, and a side panel that answers questions about any page by reading your active repos (repo-qualified citations). Settings → Extension has install help, active-repo checkboxes (default the 3 most recent) and the panel model (default muse-spark). Web-page threads are listed under Documents → Web pages; Reviews shows only PRs and branches.
322.whatToTry: Settings → Extension: Show extension folder, then load it unpacked on chrome://extensions. Open any page, open the side panel, select text and Ask.
322.caveats: Citation click-through to the app comes after v1. The panel page is plainly styled.

324.whatChanged: Plotlines show each plotline's share of all hunks (2/8) and a thin stacked bar under the title.
324.whatToTry: Open the demo guide's Plotlines card.

325.whatChanged: The diff Hide menu is an ordered category list (Uninteresting · Mechanical · Routine · Substantive · Needs attention) with swatches, counts and eye icons; clicking a row hides it and everything less important. It hides exactly what you ask: guide-cited hunks are no longer exempt, and clicking a citation to a hidden hunk reveals it. Hunk headers show only the score dot. The button shows an open eye when nothing is hidden.
325.whatToTry: Open a review diff, hide up to Routine, then click a guide citation that points into a hidden hunk.
325.caveats: Needs attention can never be hidden. The hunk prompt no longer forbids marking cited hunks uninteresting, so newly built guides may hide more.

326.whatChanged: Collapse threads moved from the guide title row to an icon in the review top bar.
326.whatToTry: Open a review with threads and use the icon after Debug in the top bar.

327.whatChanged: ### headings in guide cards now render as sub-headings (Decisions, Invariants, Known uncertainties, Interfaces).
327.caveats: Only guides written by this build get sub-headings.

328.whatChanged: Settings rows put the label and help on the left and the control alone on the right; Limits number inputs line up with units beside them.
328.whatToTry: Open Settings → Limits, Models and Appearance.

330.whatChanged: Every build ships its release notes, cumulative since the last release. Settings → Version shows each channel's notes (what updating would bring) behind its Notes button.
330.whatToTry: Open Settings → Version and press Notes on a channel.

331.whatChanged: A reply's text starts on the avatar's line and wraps back to the normal padding; a reply that opens with a list, code, diagram or table starts below the avatar.
331.whatToTry: Open a thread with replies in the guide or the diff.

332.whatChanged: Citations whose path contains ( ) [ ] (e.g. Next.js route groups and dynamic segments) or a scoped @ folder now render as chips instead of raw [[code:…]] text.
332.whatToTry: Open a review of a repo with such paths and check the guide citations hover and open the file.

333.whatChanged: The extension's Review in Unvibe button now shows on every PR tab, including the Conversation page beside Merge status and Code, in Unvibe indigo with the u mark.
333.whatToTry: Reload the extension on chrome://extensions, open a PR's Conversation tab and switch tabs.
333.caveats: Tested against fixture pages, not live GitHub.

334.whatChanged: An in-browser demo of the recorded urllib3 review is live at unvibe.xyz/demo, linked from the landing page as Try the demo. It replays the same recordings with the same matcher as the service (now shared), keeps comments in the browser with a Reset demo, and disables Submit and settings.

335.whatChanged: The extension's Review in Unvibe button now starts the review itself and opens it directly, with no confirm page; failures show on the button. Plain /open?pr= links still ask first, on a confirm page styled inside the app.
335.whatToTry: Reload the extension on chrome://extensions and click Review in Unvibe on a PR.

336.whatChanged: Reply hover controls no longer draw over the text (a compact toolbar floats beside the first line only); a citation chip can never render empty; each avatar is centred on its own first line (serif AI replies and sans human replies), in light, dark and Studio fonts. The toolbar is clickable over the reply text.
336.whatToTry: Hover an agent reply in a thread, and look at the end of a reply with citations.
